scope: Chromium rendering and UI actions with an in-memory mocked API/storage. No browser network policies were changed. This does not validate live HTTP, native authentication/cookies, real localStorage persistence, reload reconnection, SSH, Ansible, Docker or systemd execution.

checks.check: Status cards and simulation disclosure render from supplied API fixtures
1440px desktop layout has no horizontal overflow
Unchecked approval and cancellation do not submit
One approved action generates one task request with the required confirmation
Selected task ID is saved through the browser storage interface (mocked storage)
Execution output is text, not interpreted HTML
390px mobile layout has no horizontal overflow
Mobile guide renders without horizontal overflow
No unhandled JavaScript errors during the observed action/output flows

not_run: Network-backed browser_smoke.py was blocked by the environment browser URL policy; run it on the development laptop/test VM.
Real phone browser tests and live native Semaphore integration.
